packed.note: Table P (MANDT C3, ID I, AMOUNT P 15,2, TS P 15,0 -- a TIMESTAMP), key (MANDT, ID), seeded with seed before each case. A packed value is a decimal string with exactly the type's decimals; more non-zero decimals than the type, or more digits than its length, is refused (an ABAP work area cannot hold it), not rounded.

pairs.name: INSERT a packed amount and a TIMESTAMP, as decimal strings of the type

sqlite.sql: INSERT INTO "P" ("MANDT", "ID", "AMOUNT", "TS") VALUES (?, 3, ?, ?)

duckdb.sql: INSERT INTO "P" ("MANDT", "ID", "AMOUNT", "TS") VALUES (?, 3, ?, ?)

postgres.sql: INSERT INTO "P" ("MANDT", "ID", "AMOUNT", "TS") VALUES ($1::varchar(3), 3, $2::numeric(15,2), $3::numeric(15,0))

hana.sql: INSERT INTO "P" ("MANDT", "ID", "AMOUNT", "TS") VALUES (?, 3, CAST(? AS DECIMAL(15,2)), CAST(? AS DECIMAL(15,0)))
